name: Somchai Srisuk
bio:
Somchai's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination with the engineering marvels displayed at local motorcycle races. He was captivated by the intricate designs and the sheer speed of the machines. After earning a degree in Materials Engineering, Somchai honed his skills at a composite manufacturing firm before transitioning to the high-stakes world of racing. 

His meticulous approach to composite design and repair, combined with a keen understanding of aerodynamics, makes him a valuable asset to the Peugeot TotalEnergies team. Somchai is known for his ability to quickly assess damage and devise innovative repair solutions, minimizing downtime and maximizing performance. He's a quiet but confident presence in the garage, always focused on the task at hand.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed with a slight wave
physical.description: Somchai is of average height with a lean build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn notebook filled with sketches and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on surfaces while deep in thought.
Insists on personally inspecting every composite component before it's installed.
